root_cause_visible_here: NameError: name 'beacon' is not defined - the shared transport was appended after the worker's entrypoint guard, so the module ran main() before the def had executed.
why_it_is_kept: This is the ONLY place the run's root cause is readable. The receipt's own failure.json records a downstream symptom, not the cause, and AWS discards console output for a terminated instance after a while. Without this file the cause of the failure would not survive.
